definitions.explanation: A coin made of gold, either as historical currency or as a modern collectible or investment item.

examples.japanese: {金貨|きんか}を{集|あつ}めている。
{古|ふる}い{金貨|きんか}がオークションで{高値|たかね}で{落札|らくさつ}された。
examples.english: An old gold coin was sold at a high price at auction.

examples.japanese: {江戸時代|えどじだい}には{小判|こばん}と{呼|よ}ばれる{金貨|きんか}が{広|ひろ}く{流通|りゅうつう}していた。
examples.english: During the Edo period, gold coins called koban were widely circulated.

notes:
USAGE:
{金貨|きんか} refers to any gold coin, whether historical or modern. For investment-grade gold coins, terms like {地金型|じがねがた}{金貨|きんか} (bullion coin) are used.

RELATED WORDS:
- {銀貨|ぎんか} (silver coin)
- {銅貨|どうか} (copper coin)
- {硬貨|こうか} (coin — general term)
- {小判|こばん} (koban — oval gold coins from the Edo period)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金貨|きんか}を{鋳造|ちゅうぞう}する (to mint gold coins)
- {記念|きねん}{金貨|きんか} (commemorative gold coin)
- {金貨|きんか}コレクション (gold coin collection)
